update.dockerUpdateDetail:
Docker containers must be updated by pulling new images.
            Run this on your host machine:

node.activatePrompt: Do you want to activate a node on this install?
node.activateDetail: This turns on your local participant node and syncs Infonet only through available Wormhole onion/RNS peers. Clearnet bootstrap is disabled by default.
node.keepSyncing: Your node keeps syncing as long as the backend is running — you can close this browser tab. To run a headless node without the dashboard, use
node.term1: This install can keep a local copy of the public Infonet chain.
node.term2: Fresh installs do not use a clearnet Infonet seed.
node.term3: Participant-node sync requires an onion/RNS peer through Wormhole.
node.term4: Your backend may sync with configured private bootstrap peers in the background.
node.term5: Wormhole keeps Infonet, gates, Dead Drop, and DM traffic on the obfuscated lane.
node.syncTakingLong: Sync is taking longer than expected. Your node is active and will continue syncing in the background.

terminal.enterTerminal: Enter the Wormhole-facing terminal and sync with the obfuscated Infonet commons?
terminal.terminalDetail: The terminal runs through Wormhole for obfuscated gates, inbox, and experimental comms.
terminal.identityReady: Your obfuscated identity is already provisioned. Entering now keeps the obfuscated lane separate from the public node sync path.
terminal.identityNotReady: This turns Wormhole on and opens the obfuscated lane. If you already have a Wormhole identity, it reuses it. If you do not, it bootstraps one once and then keeps using it.
terminal.termTerminal1: The terminal is for Wormhole gates (transitional private lane) and Dead Drop / DM (stronger private lane).
terminal.termTerminal2: Your participant node can stay active separately without changing this obfuscated identity lane.
terminal.termTerminal3: Mesh remains the public perimeter. Wormhole is the obfuscated commons.
terminal.cleanupDetail: Closing the Infonet terminal will shut down Wormhole automatically. If you force-close the browser or the shutdown fails, Wormhole may keep running in the background. Run
terminal.cleanupFromRoot: from the project root to ensure it is fully stopped.

backend.offline: BACKEND OFFLINE — Cannot reach backend server. Check that the backend container is running and BACKEND_URL is correct.

gtUsCities.title: US PROTEST WATCH
gtUsCities.titleTooltip: City-level protest and civil-unrest OSINT watch. Scores come from Telegram/Reddit plus Game Theory unrest language — not conflict, nuclear, or war forecasts.
gtUsCities.empty: No elevated US metros yet — Telegram/Reddit protest chatter is being scanned city-by-city.
gtUsCities.igniteTooltip: 3-day risk spike: this metro’s unrest score jumped well above its recent average.
gtUsCities.potentialTooltip: Protest potential (0–100%): blend of unrest chatter and mobilization keywords. ~15% is baseline quiet; 35%+ is elevated watch. Not a civil-war or nuclear-risk score.
gtUsCities.unrestTooltip: Unrest domain (0–100%): how much recent OSINT text for this city mentions protests, rallies, strikes, riots, or mobilization. Baseline is about 15%.
gtUsCities.protestHitsTooltip: Protest hits: Reddit/Telegram posts in the last {days} days with explicit protest keywords mapped to this city.
gtUsCities.barTooltip: Red-to-blue bar = protest potential for this metro. Click the card for costly signals and dossier detail.
gtUsCities.cardTooltip: {city}: protest potential {potential}, unrest {unrest}, {mentions} protest hits. Click to fly there and open the strategic-risk dossier.
gtUsCities.mobilizationTooltip: Posts mentioning scheduled actions: direct action, rally at, meet at, mass rally, blockade, etc.

driver.feedTooltip: FEED-DRIVEN: protest potential is mostly from Telegram/Reddit protest or mobilization posts mapped to this metro (38% feed layer weight).
driver.gtTooltip: GT-DRIVEN: protest potential is mostly from Game Theory unrest/risk language without strong feed confirmation (62% GT layer weight).
driver.mixedTooltip: MIXED: Telegram/Reddit feed activity and GT unrest/risk are contributing roughly equally to this score.

gtUsCities.hint: Scores blend GT unrest with Telegram/Reddit protest + mobilization keywords. Click a city to fly there.

personalPlanning.title: PERSONAL PLANNING
personalPlanning.titleTooltip: Practical tiers for friends and family. These are OSINT awareness guides — not evacuation orders, legal advice, or predictions of war or collapse.
personalPlanning.disclaimer: Do not leave a city based on one percentage. Use converging signals: score tier, mobilization posts, IGNITE spikes, a rising multi-day trend, and what you see on the ground (transit, closures, official alerts).
personalPlanning.brooklynNote: Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, and the Bronx are all tracked under the New York City metro card.
personalPlanning.nycNow: NYC area now — potential {potential}, unrest {unrest}, {hits} protest hits, {mobilization} mobilization: {guidance}
personalPlanning.tierRoutine: <35% · steady — Normal life. Stay generally aware.
personalPlanning.tierWatch: 18–35% — Above baseline. Note protest routes; keep comms and cash handy.
personalPlanning.tierElevated: 35–55% — Elevated watch. Review go-bag, routes, and childcare/work flexibility. Avoid protest cores if risk-averse. Do not evacuate on the score alone.
personalPlanning.tierHigh: ≥55% + mobilization or IGNITE — Active prep. Consider staying out of hot zones; flexible remote work if you can.
personalPlanning.tierLeave: ≥55–60% sustained + mobilization + real-world disruption (violence, transit shutdown, official emergency orders) — Consider temporary relocation for days or weeks if you are vulnerable or mobility-limited. Leave immediately if officials order it or your neighborhood is directly affected.

guidance.routine: Routine awareness — no change to daily plans.
guidance.watch: Light watch — note local news and protest routes; no need to leave.
guidance.elevatedQuiet: Elevated watch without feed-confirmed protests. Good time to review your plan and avoid marching routes — not a signal to leave Brooklyn.
guidance.elevatedActive: Elevated with protest or mobilization chatter. Stay flexible, avoid announced action zones, and watch for IGNITE or a rising trend.
guidance.highMonitor: High score but no mobilization hits yet. Prep and monitor closely; still not an automatic leave signal.
guidance.considerRelocation: High score plus mobilization or IGNITE. If you are risk-averse or have dependents, consider staying away from hot zones; relocate only if ground truth worsens or officials say so.

gtAlerts.title: TOP ALERTS
gtAlerts.empty: No elevated regions yet — baseline theaters are tracked on the map but hidden here until risk rises above 20%.
gtAlerts.hint: Alerts are spread by theater (~100 mi); (+N) = nearby regions merged. Click to fly there.

gtRisk.noSignals: No costly-signal text matched in recent Telegram/GDELT/news for this region. Scores can rise from domain priors or nearby contagion.
gtRisk.weatherNoiseHint: storms may inflate unrest/conflict chatter — confirm costly signals.

sarGuide.intro: When optical satellites are cloud-blind, Sentinel-1 SAR still sees through weather.
sarGuide.step1: Open Layers → Earth Observation → SAR and turn it ON.
sarGuide.step2: First time only: pick Mode A (free pass catalog) or Mode B (deformation + flood alerts).
sarGuide.step3: Tap EDIT AOIs → draw a box over your area of interest → save.
sarGuide.step4: Zoom to your AOI — yellow dots are Sentinel-1 passes; orange/green are excavation signals inside the circle.

gtBacktest.title: Game Theory Backtest
gtBacktest.layerOff: Off — enable Strategic Risk Heatmap in Data Layers.
gtBacktest.disabled: Game Theory analytics disabled on server (set GT_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=true).
gtBacktest.unavailable: Backtest API unavailable — live Game Theory alerts are still active.
gtBacktest.benchmarkNote: Static labeled corpus — regression test, not live forecasting.
gtBacktest.operationalEmpty: No weekly snapshots yet — freeze runs Mondays 00:05 UTC or via OpenClaw.
gtBacktest.operationalFlat: Flat or down vs prior scorable week
gtBacktest.microEmpty: Collecting daily readings — refreshes with Game Theory ingest.
